question: A person crosses a bridge in 5.4 minutes while driving at a speed of 42 km/h. What is the length of the bridge?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert time directly into hours to match the speed unit.

Time in hours = 5.4 ÷ 60 = 0.09 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 42 × 0.09 = 3.78 km

**∴ The correct answer is 3.78 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the person = 42 km/h

Time taken to cross the bridge = 5.4 minutes

 
 
 
 
 Speed = 42 km/h
 Time = 5.4 min
 
 

 
 
 
 

 

 

 Length of Bridge = ?

 
 
 

 
 

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

1 hour = 60 minutes

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, convert the time from minutes to hours.

⇒ Time = 5.4 ÷ 60 hours

⇒ Time = 0.09 hours

⇒ Now, use the distance formula:

⇒ Length of the bridge = Distance covered

⇒ Length of the bridge = 42 × 0.09

⇒ Length of the bridge = 3.78 km

**∴ The correct answer is 3.78 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Relative Speed

If two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. In opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Average Speed

If equal distances are covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).
